buffer-enabled.name: Grounded jump buffer
buffer-enabled.description: If you tap jump in the air shortly before landing, the jump happens when you land.

buffer-window-ms.name: Buffer window (ms)
buffer-window-ms.description: How long before landing a tap still counts (1-200 ms). 16 ms is about one frame at 60 FPS. The time is measured from your tap to touchdown.

show-indicator.name: Show message when buffer fires
show-indicator.description: Flashes a small message each time the mod fires a buffered jump. Useful for testing; turn off when you're done.

debug-messages.name: Debug messages
debug-messages.description: Shows step-by-step messages for each tap (PUSH, REL, FIRED/EXPIRED). For testing only; turn off for normal play.
